rules.rule: Treat Electron main, preload, and IPC as a security boundary. Flag nodeIntegration, disabled contextIsolation, unsafe or broad preload APIs, unvalidated IPC payloads, renderer filesystem/process/shell access, command injection, arbitrary paths, external navigation, remote content, and secret exposure.
Keep main and preload responsibilities narrow and renderer code focused on UI. Security-sensitive or side-effecting actions must have clear approval UX with exact action language.
